activate_only_when: new immutable history or finalization file creation cannot be completed

requirements: fetch current ledger bytes and blob SHA
append exactly one compact JSON object followed by one newline
bind previous_ledger_blob_sha to fetched ledger SHA
verify the prior ledger bytes are an exact prefix
parse the appended suffix as exactly one JSONL record
verify that appended record has top-level record_type=HISTORY_VERIFIED and top-level RUN_ID equal to the intended RUN_ID
nested RUN_ID fields inside RUN_CORE are allowed and must equal the same intended RUN_ID; never validate uniqueness by raw substring count
history_fallback.authoritative_history_identity: ledger blob SHA immediately after verified HISTORY_VERIFIED append

requirements: latest and state must already be re-fetched and verified
fetch current ledger bytes and blob SHA
append exactly one compact JSON object followed by one newline while preserving exact prior prefix
bind previous_ledger_blob_sha to fetched ledger SHA
parse the appended suffix as exactly one JSONL record and validate top-level identity; nested repeated identity fields are not errors
finalization_fallback.authoritative_finalization_identity: ledger blob SHA immediately after verified FINALIZATION_VERIFIED append

primary_validator_note: Primary immutable-file runs remain governed by persistence_contract.json. Ledger fallback validation is structural JSONL validation, never raw RUN_ID substring counting.
